newsitem.title: USA: Fruit of the Loom reports profit for quarter.
newsitem.headline: Fruit of the Loom reports profit for quarter.

text.p: Fruit of the Loom Inc. Wednesday reported a profit of more than $43 million in the fourth quarter, compared with a huge loss a year ago, when the apparel maker took a charge to close down some manufacturing plants.
The company said it earned $43.1 million, or 56 cents a share, in the latest quarter vs. a loss of $308 million, or $4.05 a share, a year earlier. Sales jumped to $581.0 million from $508.9 million.
For the year, the Chicago-based company said it earned $151.2 million, or $1.98 a share, compared with a 1995 loss of $232.5 million, or $3.06 a share. Sales were flat at $2.4 billion.
Fruit of the Loom said its 1995 results were hurt by a charge of $158.5 million to write down the facilities that were closed.
The company said the fourth-quarter results were boosted by strong sales of blank T-shirts, casualwear fleece products, women's and girls' underwear and Gitano jeans.
Fruit of the Loom's stock was off 37.5 cents at $39.875 on the New York Stock Exchange.
